# Kuzana

> Education and investment for Kenyan companies that sell direct and own their customers: $20k equity, access to $100k working capital and 12 months of hands-on support.

Kuzana is a 12-month education and investment program for Kenyan companies with Ksh500k+ monthly revenue that sell direct and own the customer relationship (social media, WhatsApp, email or their own sales team), rather than depending on supermarkets or distributors. Each batch takes up to 7 companies. Kuzana invests $20,000 in equity and provides access to up to $100,000 in working capital, plus governance (a monthly Strategy Board), 12 months of accounting with Zoho Books, people systems and Lead Gen marketing. Every month includes one in-person workshop in Spring Valley, Nairobi, two online sessions and one session at the founder's office.

The core value proposition lies in providing a comprehensive support system that goes beyond mere funding. Kuzana offers structured education, mentorship from experienced entrepreneurs and investors, and access to a robust network. This holistic approach is tailored to help entrepreneurs navigate the challenges of growth, refine their business strategies, and prepare for significant expansion. The program is ideal for founders who have demonstrated traction and are seeking substantial support to accelerate their business development and market reach within Kenya and potentially beyond.
